markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class set [F1] and positive margins [F7] drive Tier-1 priority despite severity-3 blur.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, others 0% | All weight on Invasive |
| Conformal set | Invasive (90% coverage) | Single class, 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 98th percentile OOD [F6] | Unflagged, though atypical/blurred |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive (60%) [F5] | Mixed; closest match Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Scarce [F2]; unreliable detector (0/20 spot check) · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Scarce [F3]; descriptive (8/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Scarce [F4], favoring invasion (12/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · High text score opposes invasion (18/20 spot check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 region deletion drops risk above random (95% CI excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (95% CI includes 0); top driver normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses/necrosis are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) and 98th-percentile OOD shift mimic invasion or mask benign/in-situ architecture.
- Lesion matches closest neighbor BACH_0284 (Benign, 83%) or BACH_0117 (InSitu, 81%), misread by unreliable normal-lobules.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 8, 4, 9**: Verify invasion in top-risk regions (region 1 leads validated invasion).
2. **Regions 0, 3, 7, 9**: Check tubules (3, 7), ducts (9), and unreliable lobules (0).
3. **Regions 0–3, 4, 7, 8–11**: Verify all margins (lateral 215 µm; others 108 µm; stains blocked).
